format: sgenaxis.design version1 retained; recognized current-UI fields become explicitly represented after Owner approval; no version auto-upgrade
public_functions: parse_design_json(&str)->Result<DesignDoc,HostError>; serialize_design(&DesignDoc)->Result<String,HostError> unchanged. build_preview_html/save/load APIs unchanged and not upgraded to new persistence semantics.
unknown_policy: Reject unknown members at root/meta/node/guides before a partial typed result. Existing props remains an intentionally open nested JSON data bag; preserve supported values, do not execute strings/keys. No new root extensions bag or plugin runtime.
duplicate_policy: Reject duplicate keys at all levels, including props, with exact RFC6901 pointer. Do not accept duplicate-last-wins parsing as preservation.
optional_policy: For five new fields: absence means None and omitted on serialize; explicit null invalid, including false/0/empty arrays preserved distinctly. Old pre-existing optional/default contracts remain unchanged and explicitly normalized in comparison.
numeric_policy: H1 preserves numeric semantic value, not token formatting. Allow value only when the current HOST JSON representation can serialize/reparse it without decimal-value loss AND any mathematically integral value lies within[-9007199254740991,9007199254740991] for the JS consumer. Accept1.00/1E+03 if canonical decimal value is unchanged; reject9007199254740993, overflow, underflow or precision-losing decimal instead of silently rounding. No floating-point intermediate may be used as proof of decimal equality. Helpers remain private in the single HOST file.

proposed_limits.authority: new M03 recommendations, NOT inherited approval merely because another module uses these values

priority: input size/UTF8/BOM -> grammar/duplicate/resource guards -> format/version -> known/unknown/type checks -> numeric representation -> typed document validate; no current-state mutation or file write before success
existing_errors: Existing malformed JSON/format/version/product_pass=true refusal semantics and readable HostError::Settings remain; no new public HostError variant, no relaxed product_pass guard. New prefixes for newly rejected cases need Owner adoption.
success: Decode fully representable input and serialize/reparse all business fields equal under explicit existing-default + canonical numeric semantics; preserve the five lost field paths and original node IDs/relationships/hints/props. Never silently delete unrepresented data.
failure: Return HostError::Settings and no partial DesignDoc; caller remains responsible for installing a candidate only on full success. Source bytes untouched. This pure codec slice does not claim active-state, atomic file-save, UI, or formal snapshot acceptance.
codec_does_not_decide: root form geometry versus disagreeing formSize UI preference
cross-file graph repairs or identity remaps
